item.title: SCP *PLACE HOLDER NUMBER* The Bee movie.
item.description: This is my very first draft of an SCP, I want to know what y'all think of it.
item.content:encoded:
For context before we get into the meat of this thread, I was inspired to write this because I've often heard the bee movie be described as a collective fever dream, I feel like it could fit into the joke scp category, but I think with more tweaking it could be a full fledged article.

STAFF NOTICE: According to the Draft Forum Guidelines, please do not post your entire draft in the forums. Make a sandbox page, and keep your draft there.

If the only copy of your draft is in this post, you can recover the text by clicking the 'Last edited on [dd/mm/yyyy], [time] by [username] Show more' section found in lower right corner of this post. Then click 'Show revision' to find the full draft from before. Copy that full draft and paste it into your sandbox page. Please note that 'Show revision' does not change the post back.

item.title: Dysphoric Flesh
item.description: Currently seeking feedback from all, but esp. trans users
item.content:encoded:
CW/TW: Discussion of trans trauma, dysphoria, and suicide, by a trans individual.

http://scp-sandbox-3.wikidot.com/oystershell Look under the "Dysphoric Flesh" "Brood of my Brood, Skin of my Skin" tab.

This is a story about what truly horrifies me most. In case it's not clear, I'm trans myself.

While anyone and everyone's thoughts and critiques are welcome, I am especially keen on receiving feedback from other trans and non-binary folks.

EDIT 1: Draft 2 is now up. Draft 2 contains revised ConProcs, a slew of small edits and revisions to the Description including addressing almost all of cybersqyd's LBL's, and the addition of a reproductive system for the SCP. Still looking for feedback on sensitivity, as well as critique on the overall narrative and flow, as well as advice on how to stick the landing if the current ending is underwhelming for you. Also added an image and revised the title.

Thanks in advance.

item.title: The Friendly Shadow
item.description: Clarence's Shadow is sapient, alive, and his best friend.
item.content:encoded:
Aloha guys! Here's my first attempt at an SCP. It's filled with 1,551 words. I know it definitely needs work, but because I'm basically blind, I'm sure whoever stumbles upon this can easily correct my mistakes faster.
So, have at it: http://scp-sandbox-3.wikidot.com/drcope

Greenlights in the replies.

Brief Intro: It's a living shadow attached to a human (Clarence).

I believe I must certainly work on the Interviews. Other than that, I'm not observant or educated enough to see what else needs corrected. To anyone about to Crit this, thanks.
